question: Which TV star just got left out of her own show's cast photo?
story: The star of Grey's Anatomy just got left out of the Grey's Anatomy cast photo. On July twenty fourth, the show posted its season twenty three cast photo to Instagram. Chandra Wilson was there. Debbie Allen was there. Camilla Luddington, Caterina Scorsone, James Pickens Junior, plus a whole row of new faces. Missing? Ellen Pompeo. As in Meredith Grey. As in the woman the entire show is named after, who has played that role since two thousand five. Fans lost it in the comments, pointing out that you cannot really have Grey's Anatomy without Grey. Here is the calmer version. Pompeo scaled back her screen time starting in season nineteen to spend more time with her family, and reports say she is still expected to appear in multiple episodes this season. So she is not gone. She just was not in the picture. Twenty one seasons in, that is still a brutal way to find out.
